name: Private Bancorp of America, Inc.
summary: Private Bancorp of America, Inc. operates as the bank holding company for CalPrivate Bank that provides banking products and services to individuals and businesses in California. The company offers checking and savings, mobile deposit, money market, certificate of deposit, and retirement accounts; lending services, including commercial real estate loans, commercial and industrial loans, and government-guaranteed lending programs; ATM and debit cards, and credit cards; and safe deposit boxes. It also provides online business banking services, such as online tools, specialized features, deposit one remote deposit capture, bill pay, account reconciliation, ACH origination, and positive pay; and…
